review.posthog_relevance: Adds connection-target change detection and credential preservation checks, but the tier is capped at 1 because the actual credential clearing and re-entry enforcement implementation is absent from this chunk.
review.reason: This chunk provides helper functions and tests for connection-target change detection and credential preservation, but the critical implementation of credential clearing and re-entry gating is not present. The score is assigned based on the observable helper and test additions, not the missing enforcement behavior.
review.uncertainty: The tier depends on the actual credential clearing and re-entry enforcement, which is not included in this chunk. The score reflects only the helper and test, not the full enforcement capability.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the credential re-entry gating or the credential clearing behavior, only the helper functions and the test. The tier depends on the actual credential clearing and re-entry enforcement, not the helper or the test.
